indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inbox_messages_pkey ON public.inbox_messages USING btree (consumer_name, message_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_pending ON public.outbox_events USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE (published_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_transaction ON public.outbox_events USING btree ((((payload -> 'data'::text) ->> 'transactionId'::text)), event_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_events_pkey ON public.outbox_events USING btree (event_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_tx_pending ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'PENDING_REFERENCE'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tx_external ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (provider_id, external_transaction_id) WHERE (origin = 'EXTERNAL'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tx_idempotency ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (provider_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (origin = 'EXTERNAL'::text)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tx_one_reversal ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (reference_transaction_id) WHERE ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['REFUND'::text, 'ROLLBACK'::text])) AND (status = 'PROCESSED'::text))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tx_one_reversal_per_kind ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (reference_transaction_id, kind) WHERE ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['REFUND'::text, 'ROLLBACK'::text])) AND (status = 'PROCESSED'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tx_opening ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (wallet_id) WHERE (kind = 'OPENING'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wager_transactions_pkey ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_ledger_wallet_seq ON public.wallet_ledger_entries USING btree (wallet_id, seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_seq_unique ON public.wallet_ledger_entries USING btree (seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_ledger_entries_pkey ON public.wallet_ledger_entries USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_ledger_entries_wallet_id_transaction_id_key ON public.wallet_ledger_entries USING btree (wallet_id, transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallets_pkey ON public.wallets USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallets_player_id_currency_key ON public.wallets USING btree (player_id, currency)
